notes_for_editor: Thin: one compiled list (tnlandforms.us, map revised 2016) is the only tower-specific source; not on the NHLR or former-sites lists per the cached indexes. No build date, design, height, staffing, fires, status or access found. The list says names for towers 73 and above are the compiler's own creation, so 'Newman' may be a list name rather than a historic one. The page does not explain the BLL or gfc numbering beyond the two lines quoted, and gives elevation (976) with no unit; the tower record converts it to 297.5 m. Two web searches found nothing tower-specific. A 2006 Savannah Morning News piece on Georgia fire towers (search snippet only; the site returned 403) is a lead for state context, not used. Not verified on the ground. Re-checked 2026-10-21 against the live register HTML: the NHLR table (29 tower rows) and the former-sites table (2 rows) contain no Newman entry; the story's wording was rewritten to avoid copying the source phrase for the 203-tower list.
